triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER membership_status_change BEFORE UPDATE ON public.class_memberships FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION on_membership_status_change()
CREATE TRIGGER normalize_class_fields_trigger BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.classes FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION normalize_class_fields()
CREATE TRIGGER validate_dojo_admin_assignment_trigger BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.dojo_admin_assignments FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION validate_dojo_admin_assignment()
CREATE TRIGGER normalize_dojo_fields_trigger BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.dojos FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION normalize_dojo_fields()
CREATE TRIGGER normalize_email_outbox_trigger BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.email_outbox FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION normalize_email_outbox()

CREATE TRIGGER guard_deceased_profile_fields_trigger BEFORE UPDATE OF date_of_passing, account_status ON public.profiles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_deceased_profile_fields()
